name: swing
description: Global Swing: with Config > Project Settings > Global Swing > Global swing On, every take and every pattern start uses the project's Swing amount (25-75); a Swing FX still changes it until the pattern starts again

branches.note: app_audio_block: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600aa858); first the global swing at a take's start or a settings change
render loop: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600bc2d8); the same, so renders swing too
Config menu constructor: Project Settings folder, room for one more item
Config menu constructor: last item (Licenses); then adds the Global Swing folder (Global swing, Swing amount) to Project Settings
save request 0x60114e34, Save As only: bl strncpy(fm+0x340, name, 0x21) -> mt_sw_save_name (the settings go with the project to its new name)

words.note: ITCM image (copied to ITCM 0x1f81c at boot): the word seq_tick's veneer jumps through to seq_advance_step 0x600ad011 -> mt_sw_advance_step (the global swing again when a pattern starts)
project screen vtable: update method 0x600ead59 -> mt_sw_project_update (a new project seen before its first save)
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_sw_pattern_update (settings file load/save)
Config screen vtable: update method 0x600c6475 -> mt_sw_config_update (settings file load/save)
